text: Computer vision is a type of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand images and videos. One important part is image recognition, which allows a computer to identify what is in a picture, such as a person, an animal, or an object. Another key idea is object detection, which means finding where objects are located in an image. Computer vision has many useful applications in daily life. For example, it is used in self-driving cars to help them see the road, recognise other vehicles, and avoid accidents. It is also used in security cameras and medical images. Computer vision is changing the way we live and work.
